titles.romaji: Genki Genki Nontan: Spoon Tan Tan Tan
titles.native: げんきげんきノンタン　スプーン たんたんたん

description: This edition focuses on teaching kids good house manners. Such as eating all the food on your plate; to taking naps when instructed to so you can grow up big and strong; to avoiding wetting the bed and how to handle the situation if you do.
